# v1.10.0 — Supplier order export and Nabava housekeeping

## Supplier export

- Added **Pošalji e-mailom** export for unchecked/open Nabava items only, preventing purchased items from being repeated in a later order.
- Web opens a prefilled `mailto:` message and copies the same plain text to the clipboard as a fallback; mobile uses the native share sheet with the order text.

## List management and fixes

- Added **Izbriši Preuzete Stvari** to delete checked entries across all lists, with a confirmation and disabled state when none are checked.
- Sort checked items below open ones, with most recently checked first, using an idempotent `checked_at` migration.
- Fixed renaming a checked item silently unchecking it. PATCH routes now treat title and completion state as independent optional fields.
- Broadcast board/Nabava sync events after clearing entries so open screens refresh.

## Verification

- API and browser checks verified export, ordering, rename-preserves-checked state, and bulk clear; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis and all 9 Flutter tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.10.0+10**.
